text:
Jess (Product): quick async check — posting the qtr checkpoint for the Catalog project. TL;DR: catalog search v2 shipped to canary, ingest pipeline slipped, and autoscaling rollout needs ownership clarification. please mark ✅ for shipped, 🚧 for slipped, and assign owners.

Jess (Product): Milestone A — Search v2 (canary): shipped ✅ (canary live in us-west, low traffic). Owner: Alex. Next step: expand to eu and add perf test.

Alex (ENG): noted. canary metrics look good. will schedule eu rollout next week. tagging PRs: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/412 and https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/419

Maya - PM: Alex — can you confirm whether eu rollout needs infra changes or just config? we should clear dependencies before the 3/28 demo.

Alex (ENG): should be config-only, no infra changes. I'll run smoke across eu region once traffic switch is staged. ETA Tue 3/25.

Jess (Product): Milestone B — Ingest pipeline refactor: slipped 🚧. Original owner: Samir. Blockers: backfill window is larger than expected, and we discovered a schema edge-case.

Samir (Infra): yep, slipped. root cause: the protobuf schema change caused a small subset of legacy records to error, and backfill needs a safer convergent migration. I estimated +2 weeks.

Taylor (SRE): Samir — what's the rollback plan if the backfill causes downstream latency? we can throttle, but need a runbook.

Samir (Infra): good call. current plan: run backfill at 10% traffic -> monitor ingest latency -> ramp. fallback: switch to replay-only mode and pause materialized views. I'll draft a runbook today.

Jess (Product): Milestone C — Autoscaling rollout for dedicated pools: partial ship (config applied to dev and staging) but prod rollout not started. Owner unclear.

Maya - PM: I thought Dedicated infra was owning this? Samir, can you confirm?

Samir (Infra): infra set the autoscaler framework, but production rollout requires app-level hooks from Catalog team (graceful cache eviction + readiness). Alex, does Catalog have readiness hooks implemented?

Alex (ENG): we have basic readiness but not cache-aware eviction. that'll be a small change (2–3 days). happy to own it if infra pairs for the first rollout.

Taylor (SRE): SRE can be on the rollout. propose pairing session Wed 3/20 10:00am PT to run canary ramp and validate latency SLO.

Jess (Product): action items: 1) Alex schedule eu rollout (owner: Alex) — due 3/25; 2) Samir deliver backfill runbook + ETA — due 3/18; 3) Alex + Samir + Taylor pair for autoscaler prod rollout — session Wed 3/20 10:00am PT; 4) Maya to update stakeholder doc with new dates.

Alex (ENG): ✅ added eu rollout to my board. will post update once smoke passes.

Samir (Infra): 🚧 backfill runbook draft inbound by EOD 3/18. will include rollback commands. snippet: ```
# replay-only switch
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/ingest/control -d '{"mode":"replay_only"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

Taylor (SRE): putting Wed 3/20 10am PT on my calendar. will create an incident channel for the rollout: #inc-catalog-autoscale

Maya - PM: I'll update the milestone doc and ping execs after we confirm dates. one more ask: can each owner add a one-line risk and mitigation next to their milestone in the doc?

Alex (ENG): added risk: EU latency spike during rollout. mitigation: staged traffic ramp + perf test.

Samir (Infra): added risk: backfill corrupts materialized view. mitigation: replay-only switch + validation checks.

Jess (Product): thanks all. last ask — any code review blockers? please drop PR links and short statuses.

Alex (ENG): PRs ready; 412 needs a quick review from @Samir on infra config. 419 is waiting on a small test update.

Samir (Infra): reviewing #412 now. will leave comments by EOD.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled: catalog-search-v2-canary -> us-west at 1765403600 (automated).

Taylor (SRE): once Samir posts runbook, I'll add SLO knobs to the runbook and the dashboard widget.

Jess (Product): perfect — will follow up next Tue for status updates. thanks for the quick responses :thumbsup:
